new_results.statement: For either transverse bank with G>=kappa I, sum_j(u^T Lambda r_j)^2 >= kappa(sqrt(1-a^2)-|a|/sqrt(kappa))^2. At kappa=7/800, |a|<=.01 and heavy leverage c>3/10, the physical cross-row norm into each bank is at least r_*=0.0457549664530082.

On the hard exact-rank3 near-null/two-transverse-bank residual, |phi_Q(t)|<=min(1,9.85401716907443 |t|^-1/2), hence every interval I obeys P(Q in I)<=min(1,19.7603302022318 sqrt(|I|)). This is uniform over arbitrary cap-one product laws and support fragmentation; it does not imply a bounded density.

next_obligation.statement: Upgrade the proved sqrt-small-ball bound to a linear slab bound by jointly exploiting same-bank transverse curvature and dependent orthogonal leakage, uniformly as both leakage variances tend to zero; do not use worst conditional caps or perturbation by coefficient size.
